construct: a 0px or 0fr track written to the canvas
why: The API silently REWRITES zero tracks (0px snaps to rendered size, 0fr clamps to 1fr) — a silent-invention hazard the schema must fence out.
expectWhere: LEDGER.md / refusal receipts (schema fence: GRID_REFUSALS grid-track-zero)

canvas.note: unrepresentable: normalized away at write time

codeToCanvas.note: schema-invalid before emit; emitting would trigger the silent normalization (N-DISP-02)

canvasToCode.note: the canvas cannot HOLD a zero track — the write is rewritten on entry (P2b), so no canvas artifact exists to read

probe: P2b: {FIXED,0} read back as {FIXED,200}; {FLEX,0} read back as {FLEX,1} — accepted, silently rewritten
